manual_image_review.note: All source crops were inspected together for identity, legibility and misleading reuse before publication.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Six inspectable historical sources plus archival image pages; the 2017/2026 boundary and album purpose are explicit.

coverage_and_completion.note: Four image-ready collections, eleven milestones, People claims, language, Story, reading tracks, History A–H and 4x7 quiz are materialized.

editorial_quality.note: The account distinguishes reform rhetoric from outcomes, Botsen from Bayer'n, and institutional imagery from inmate experience.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic finalizer, canonical manifests, local assets, v4.2 packet and targeted test are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: No spectacle or famous-inmate framing; isolation harms, source asymmetry and absent inmate voices are handled explicitly.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sentence mapping, image provenance, source limitations, holdbacks and permanent tests provide a reproducible audit trail.
